meta.title: Create a match pool
meta.description: Fund a match on tokenized SPYx savings in one transaction. Savers earn it as it vests.

title: Create a match pool
subtitle: Fund a match. People who deposit {symbol} earn it as it vests.

details.title: Name your pool
details.description: Savers see this on the pool page. You sign it with your wallet, so nobody else can change it.

about.label: What is this pool for?
about.placeholder: Who it's for, and why you're funding it.

rules.title: Set the rules
rules.description: Rules can't change after the pool is created, so savers can rely on them.

match.label: Match rate
match.hint: The sponsor adds this share of every deposit. 100% is one-for-one.

cap.label: Most one saver can deposit
cap.hint: This also limits the match one saver can earn.

vesting.label: Match vests over
vesting.hint: Savers earn the match in a straight line over this time, starting when they deposit.

window.label: Deposits stay open for
window.hint: Then the pool closes to new deposits, and you can reclaim match nobody reserved.

fund.title: Fund the match
fund.description: When you create the pool, this much {symbol} moves from your wallet into the pool's vault. You can reclaim whatever savers haven't reserved once the pool closes.

budget.label: Match budget
budget.notConnected: Connect a wallet to see your balance.

reach.title: What this buys
reach.savers: {count, plural, one {# saver} other {# savers}} matched in full
reach.each: Each deposits up to {cap} {symbol} and earns {match} {symbol}.
reach.none: At these rules a deposit at the limit earns no match, so the budget would never be spent.

fund.demoCap: Demo limit: on mainnet, the budget and each saver's limit are capped at {cap} {symbol}.
fund.noBalance: You don't hold any {symbol}. Get some first, then come back to fund a pool.

review.title: Review and create
review.description: One transaction creates the pool and funds it. Your wallet asks you to approve it once.

disclosure.locked: {amount} {symbol} moves into the pool. Matches are paid from it. After {date} you can reclaim what savers haven't reserved.
disclosure.final: The rules above can't be changed once the pool exists.
disclosure.issuer: {symbol}'s issuer can pause transfers, freeze accounts and move tokens out of any account, including this pool's vault. The pool page lists these powers, read live from the chain.
disclosure.upgrade: The program can be upgraded by {authority}, who could change how pools behave.
disclosure.demo: Demo — this does not constitute an offer of securities.

review.connect: Connect a wallet to create the pool
review.paused: The issuer has paused {symbol} transfers, so a pool can't be funded right now.
review.notReady: The pool program isn't configured on this deployment.

created.title: Your pool is live
created.description: It's on Solana and open for deposits until {date}.

publish.title: Publish its name
publish.description: Sign a message so savers see "{name}". Signing is free and moves nothing.
publish.signing: Approve the signature in your wallet
publish.error: Couldn't publish the name. The pool works without it, and you can try again.
publish.unsupported: This wallet can't sign messages, so the pool shows a numbered name for now.
publish.cancelled: You cancelled the signature. Nothing was published.

problems.characters: That contains characters that aren't allowed.
problems.demoCapUnset: Pool creation is closed on mainnet until a demo limit is configured.

outOfRange.matchPercent: The match rate must be between 0.01% and 100%.
outOfRange.vesting: Vesting must last between 30 seconds and 5 years.
outOfRange.window: Deposits must stay open between 10 minutes and 5 years.

preview.title: Your pool so far
preview.pending: Fill in the numbers and the pool takes shape here.
preview.ringLabel: The sponsor adds {percent} of every deposit
preview.savers: {count, plural, one {saver} other {savers}} matched in full
